note: Year 11 Foundation Foundation Spring Block 4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry: one set of templates per small step of the scheme of learning.

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S1 Angles in lines and shapes
templates.text: Angle $x$ and a [[a]]° angle are on a straight line. Another angle $y$ is in a triangle with angles [[a]]° and [[b]]°. Work out $x$ and $y$.

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S1 Angles in lines and shapes
templates.text: An isosceles triangle has a base angle of [[b]]°. Work out its top angle, and the angle between one slanting side and a straight line through the base.
templates.answer: Top angle [[180 - 2 * b]]°; exterior angle [[180 - b]]°

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S1 Angles in lines and shapes
templates.text: Two angles on a straight line are $x$ and [[a]]°. One of them is also an angle of a triangle with another angle [[c]]°. Find the third angle of the triangle if it uses $x$.

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S1 Angles in lines and shapes
templates.text: Three angles meet at a point: [[a]]°, [[b]]° and $x$. $x$ is also one of the angles in a triangle with angles [[c]]° and $y$. Find $x$ and $y$. (4 marks)

templates.subtopic: Solve problems with angles in parallel lines
templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S2 Solve problems with angles in parallel lines
templates.text: $ABCD$ is a trapezium with $AB$ parallel to $DC$. Angle $A$ is [[p]]°. Find angle $D$.

templates.subtopic: Solve problems with angles in parallel lines
templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S2 Solve problems with angles in parallel lines
templates.text: A triangle $PQR$ lies between two parallel lines. The angle at $P$ with the top line is [[p]]° and at $Q$ with the bottom line is [[q]]° (alternate angles inside the triangle). Find angle $R$.
templates.answer: [[180 - p - q]]° (angles in a triangle, using alternate angles)

templates.subtopic: Solve problems with angles in parallel lines
templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S2 Solve problems with angles in parallel lines
templates.text: $ABCD$ is a trapezium with $AB$ parallel to $DC$. Angle $A$ = $(2x + [[c]])°$ and angle $D$ = $(x + [[d]])°$. Find $x$ and angle $D$.

templates.subtopic: Solve problems with angles in parallel lines
templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S2 Solve problems with angles in parallel lines
templates.text: $AB$ and $CD$ are parallel. $E$ is a point between them. Angle $BAE$ is [[p]]° and angle $ECD$ is [[q]]°. Find angle $AEC$ by drawing a line through $E$ parallel to $AB$. (3 marks)
templates.answer: [[p + q]]° (alternate angles on each side of the parallel line added together)

templates.subtopic: Solve problems with angles and algebra (E)
templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S3 Solve problems with angles and algebra (E)
templates.text: The angles of a triangle are $x°$, $(x + [[a]])°$ and $(x + [[b]])°$. Find $x$.

templates.subtopic: Solve problems with angles and algebra (E)
templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S3 Solve problems with angles and algebra (E)
templates.text: The angles of a quadrilateral are $x°$, $[[p]]x°$, $(x + [[a]])°$ and [[b]]°. Find $x$.

templates.subtopic: Solve problems with angles and algebra (E)
templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S3 Solve problems with angles and algebra (E)
templates.text: Two angles on a straight line are $(3x + [[a]])°$ and $(2x - [[b]])°$. Find $x$ and both angles.

templates.subtopic: Solve problems with angles and algebra (E)
templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S3 Solve problems with angles and algebra (E)
templates.text: An isosceles triangle has base angles $(2x + [[a]])°$ and a top angle $(x - [[b]])°$. Find $x$ and the three angles. (4 marks)

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S4 Compass points and related angles
templates.text: What is the bearing of [[k == 0|if:N/]][[k == 1|if:NE/]][[k == 2|if:E/]][[k == 3|if:SE/]][[k == 4|if:S/]][[k == 5|if:SW/]][[k == 6|if:W/]][[k == 7|if:NW/]] from the centre of a compass?

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S4 Compass points and related angles
templates.text: What is the angle between [[k == 0|if:N/]][[k == 1|if:NE/]][[k == 2|if:E/]][[k == 3|if:SE/]][[k == 4|if:S/]][[k == 5|if:SW/]][[k == 6|if:W/]][[k == 7|if:NW/]] and East?

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S4 Compass points and related angles
templates.text: A walker faces [[k == 0|if:N/]][[k == 1|if:NE/]][[k == 2|if:E/]][[k == 3|if:SE/]][[k == 4|if:S/]][[k == 5|if:SW/]][[k == 6|if:W/]][[k == 7|if:NW/]] and turns clockwise through [[t]]°. Which direction (as a bearing) does the walker face now?

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S4 Compass points and related angles
templates.text: A ship sails from port $P$ towards [[k == 0|if:N/]][[k == 1|if:NE/]][[k == 2|if:E/]][[k == 3|if:SE/]][[k == 4|if:S/]][[k == 5|if:SW/]][[k == 6|if:W/]][[k == 7|if:NW/]] then changes course by [[t]]° anticlockwise. Give the new bearing and the nearest compass point. (3 marks)
templates.answer: Bearing [[(k * 45 - t + 360) % 360]]°; compass point [[((k * 45 - t + 360) % 360) / 45|dp:0]] (45° per point from N)

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S5 Understand and represent bearings
templates.text: Write [[b]]° as a three-figure bearing.

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S5 Understand and represent bearings
templates.text: The bearing of $B$ from $A$ is [[b]]°. Is $B$ north-east, south-east, south-west or north-west of $A$ (roughly)?

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S5 Understand and represent bearings
templates.text: The bearing of $B$ from $A$ is [[b]]°. Work out the bearing of $A$ from $B$.

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S5 Understand and represent bearings
templates.text: A boat sails on a bearing of [[b]]° for [[d]] km then on the reverse (back) bearing for [[d]] km. Where does it finish? What is the reverse bearing? (2 marks)
templates.answer: Back to the start; reverse bearing [[(b + 180) % 360]]°

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S6 Measure and read bearings
templates.text: From north, a line is measured clockwise with a protractor as [[b]]°. Write the bearing in three figures.

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S6 Measure and read bearings
templates.text: Measuring from north anticlockwise, a line makes an angle of [[b]]°. What is its bearing?

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S6 Measure and read bearings
templates.text: A line makes an angle of [[b]]° with south, measured clockwise (towards the west). Find its bearing from north.

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S6 Measure and read bearings
templates.text: A protractor shows [[b]]° from north to the line $AB$ (clockwise). Write the bearing of $B$ from $A$ and of $A$ from $B$. (2 marks)

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S7 Scale drawings using bearings
templates.text: A map has scale 1 cm : [[s]] km. Two towns are [[d]] cm apart. How far apart are they?

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S7 Scale drawings using bearings
templates.text: A ship sails [[D]] km on a bearing of [[b]]°. On a scale drawing of 1 cm : [[s]] km, how long is the line?

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S7 Scale drawings using bearings
templates.text: A scale drawing (1 cm : [[s]] km) shows a ship leaving port $P$ on a bearing of [[b]]° with a line [[d]] cm long. Work out the real distance and the bearing from the ship back to $P$.

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S7 Scale drawings using bearings
templates.text: A boat leaves $A$ and sails [[d1]] km on a bearing of 090° then [[d2]] km on a bearing of 000°. On a scale of 1 cm : [[s]] km, how long are the two lines and how far from $A$ is the boat (straight line)? (3 marks)
templates.answer: [[d1 / s]] cm and [[d2 / s]] cm; distance [[sqrt(d1 * d1 + d2 * d2)|dp:1]] km

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S8 Calculate bearings using angle rules (E)
templates.text: The bearing of $B$ from $A$ is [[b]]°. Find the bearing of $A$ from $B$.

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S8 Calculate bearings using angle rules (E)
templates.text: The bearing of $B$ from $A$ is [[b]]°. $C$ is due east of $B$. Find angle $ABC$ in the triangle (angle at $B$ between $BA$ and $BC$ pointing east) when [[b]] < 90.
templates.answer: [[b + 90|dp:0]]° (angle between the back bearing line and east)

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S8 Calculate bearings using angle rules (E)
templates.text: The bearing of $B$ from $A$ is [[b]]°. The bearing of $C$ from $B$ is [[c]]°. Work out angle $ABC$ using the bearing of $A$ from $B$.

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S8 Calculate bearings using angle rules (E)
templates.text: The bearing of $B$ from $A$ is [[b]]° and $AB = AC$. Angle $BAC$ = [[x]]°. Find the possible bearings of $C$ from $A$ and angle $ABC$. (3 marks)

templates.subtopic: Choose appropriate methods to solve problems with right-angled triangles
templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S9 Choose appropriate methods to solve problems with right-angled triangles
templates.text: In a right-angled triangle you know the [[k == 0|if:opposite and hypotenuse/]][[k == 1|if:adjacent and hypotenuse/]][[k == 2|if:opposite and adjacent/]] and want an angle. Which ratio do you use?

templates.subtopic: Choose appropriate methods to solve problems with right-angled triangles
templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S9 Choose appropriate methods to solve problems with right-angled triangles
templates.text: You know the hypotenuse and an angle and want the side adjacent to the angle. Which ratio do you use? Write the equation for a hypotenuse of [[h]] cm and angle [[t]]°.

templates.subtopic: Choose appropriate methods to solve problems with right-angled triangles
templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S9 Choose appropriate methods to solve problems with right-angled triangles
templates.text: A right-angled triangle has an angle of [[t]]° and the side opposite it is [[o]] cm. Find (a) the hypotenuse (b) the adjacent side, to 1 decimal place.

templates.subtopic: Choose appropriate methods to solve problems with right-angled triangles
templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S9 Choose appropriate methods to solve problems with right-angled triangles
templates.text: A kite flies on a string of [[l]] m at an angle of [[t]]° to the ground. Find the height of the kite and how far along the ground the person is from the point under it. Give answers to 1 decimal place. (4 marks)
templates.answer: Height [[l * sin(t)|dp:1]] m; distance [[l * cos(t)|dp:1]] m

templates.subtopic: Solve problems with bearings using Pythagoras and trigonometry (E)
templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S10 Solve problems with bearings using Pythagoras and trigonometry (E)
templates.text: A ship sails [[d]] km on a bearing of [[t]]°. How far north has it travelled? (Give to 1 decimal place.)

templates.subtopic: Solve problems with bearings using Pythagoras and trigonometry (E)
templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S10 Solve problems with bearings using Pythagoras and trigonometry (E)
templates.text: A ship sails [[d]] km on a bearing of [[t]]°. How far east has it travelled? (Give to 1 decimal place.)

templates.subtopic: Solve problems with bearings using Pythagoras and trigonometry (E)
templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S10 Solve problems with bearings using Pythagoras and trigonometry (E)
templates.text: A plane flies [[a]] km north then [[b]] km east. Find its distance from the start and the bearing from the start (to 1 decimal place).
templates.answer: [[sqrt(a * a + b * b)|dp:1]] km; bearing [[atan(b / a)|dp:1]]°

templates.subtopic: Solve problems with bearings using Pythagoras and trigonometry (E)
templates.source: Y11 Foundation Spring B4 Angles, bearings and trigonometry · S10 Solve problems with bearings using Pythagoras and trigonometry (E)
templates.text: $B$ is [[a]] km north and [[b]] km west of $A$. Find the distance $AB$ and the bearing of $B$ from $A$ (to 1 decimal place). (4 marks)
templates.answer: $AB$ = [[sqrt(a * a + b * b)|dp:1]] km; bearing [[360 - atan(b / a)|dp:1]]°
